title: Polish Basmati Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic side dish, combining the nutty taste of basmati rice with the savory essence of polish sausage.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove sausage from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add pilaf mix and stir to combine with onion and garlic.
Add rice to skillet and stir to combine with pilaf mix.
Add sausage back into skillet and stir to combine with rice mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
